verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the SDK is provider-agnostic, supporting OpenAI Responses/Chat Completions APIs plus 100+ other LLMs via LiteLLM-style integrations, and allow mixing models/providers per agent or per run without rewriting agent logic; env vars like OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL further ease switching. missing for 10: independent hands-on report specifically demonstrating a provider swap in a real project (only vendor docs/GitHub readme evidence, no community confirmation of this specific capability).
